title: fix(metadata-protocol): a peer replica prepares an object authored elsewhere through the writer's storage sync
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQA6UkMJumVEmV4P5Hembey)_

Fixes #32145

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多副本部署里，副本 B 从集群元数据通道得知副本 A 在运行时新建的对象后，现在会跑和 A 保存时同一个存储同步入口（`ensureObjectStorage`），不再只注册对象。
- 为什么改：B 的 SQL 驱动只在这次同步里建立自动编号计数器和组织列登记；B 没跑，于是 B 上新建的记录编号为空，租户成员在 B 上新建记录被 400「Organization is required」拒绝，要重启才好（cloud HA 演练 P04/P08）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响收到集群提示的对端，单节点（进程内集群驱动）根本不挂这条通道；同步是幂等的（表已在，只登记驱动状态），失败只记 error 不让收敛失败。回滚＝revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-class-head.ts` 的 `applyRemoteMetadataMutation`（新增一行调用 + 文档），`packages/runtime/src/cluster-metadata-mutation-resync.integration.test.ts` 新增的 `[#32145]` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/cluster-metadata-mutation-resync.integration.test.ts`，预期 6/6 通过（两个 ⭐ 为双副本场景，一个 CONTROL 为写入副本自身）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`applyRemoteMetadataMutation` (the `metadata.mutated` lane's receive path, lane 2 of `MetadataClusterBridgePlugin`) re-registered a peer-authored object from the peer's own `sys_metadata` read, and stopped there. The writer's save door runs one more step right after its write-through: `ensureObjectStorage` → `engine.syncObjectSchema` → the driver's `syncSchema`. That step is where a SQL driver builds its per-object state: `autoNumberFields` (the counter), `tenantFieldByTable` (the organization column it stamps on insert and scopes native reads on), and its other per-object coercion registries. The table already exists in the shared database, so on a peer nothing looked missing, but the peer's driver never learned the object, until a restart's boot sync.

The receive path now calls the same `ensureObjectStorage(type, name)` entry point after its write-through, when the active row exists (not on the delete/heal branch). It is the writer's own entry point, not a second copy: `object` syncs the object, `object_extension` syncs its target, every other type returns at the guard. Order matches the writer (registry, then storage), and the writer emits only after its own sync, so a peer's sync finds the table and columns in place. A refused sync is reported at `error` by that entry point and does not fail the convergence. The lane-2 resync after a cluster outage converges through the same applier, so it gets the preparation too.

The single-node path is unchanged: lane 2 attaches only on a cluster driver that crosses a process boundary, and the save door is untouched.

## Tests

New top-level `describe('[#32145] …')` in the existing two-kernel harness `packages/runtime/src/cluster-metadata-mutation-resync.integration.test.ts` (two `ObjectQL` engines and two protocols over one SQLite file, the real `MetadataClusterBridgePlugin`, a bus that crosses "process" boundaries as far as the bridge can tell):

- ⭐ B numbers the autonumber of an object authored on A (`TK-0001`).
- ⭐ B stamps `organization_id` on a tenant member's create of an object authored on A.
- CONTROL: the authoring replica A numbers and stamps the same writes (the single-node save path).
- The harness's existing CONTROL keeps pinning that on the in-process `memory` driver no lane attaches.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise re-measured on `main` (8523ef9a)**, as the ablation leg below: B's create returned `ticket_number: null`, and B's member create threw `ValidationError: Organization is required` (from `envelopeNotNullViolation`), the card's 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`. A's same writes were numbered and stamped.
- The `error` line `ensureObjectStorage` prints on a refused sync says "was published"; on a peer it reports the same fact (storage not prepared, fix by re-publish or restart). Not reworded here, to keep one entry point.
- After a cluster outage, the lane-2 resync now runs one schema sync per active object row it re-converges (idempotent; the boot does the same for every object).
- Other inventory rows of the HA drill are out of scope (not touched).

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation (fix removed → red; restored → green), rebuilt dist each leg</summary>

The suite resolves `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through its built `dist/`, so each leg rebuilt it and proved the marker on disk.

- Mutate: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-class-head.ts --anchor "await host.ensureObjectStorage(type, evt.name);" --delete --hold` → `anchor 1 -> 0`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build`; `ablation-dist-preflight … --absent` → marker absent from all 24 built files.
- Run: `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`: `expected null to be 'TK-0001'`; `ValidationError: Organization is required`.
- Restore: `ablation-replace --restore` → blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuild; preflight → hit in `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.cjs`.
- Run: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 6 passed (6)`.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

All on head `7c95359b` (base `origin/main` 8523ef9a; `origin/main` has not moved since).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/cluster-metadata-mutation-resync.integration.test.ts`: `Tests 6 passed (6)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: `Test Files 331 passed | 5 skipped (336)`, `Tests 22655 passed | 29 skipped (22684)`. The five suites that drive the peer path (`protocol.cluster-mutation-fanout`, `protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation`, `meta-overlay-cache`, `protocol.datasource-delete-prolongation`, `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling`) print no storage-sync line after the change.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` → 64 derived; `--ran`: 63 run (all exit 0), 1 NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, needs a full `pnpm build`); CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and exit 0 after fetching its pinned fixture commit.
- Not run locally: the full `@objectstack/runtime` suite (only the one edited file) and `test:repo`; CI's `Test Core` runs them. No dogfood (no `!`, no narrowing arm).
</details>
